import json,sys,os,subprocess,re
try:
  inp=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
  sys.exit(0)
if inp.get('stop_hook_active'): sys.exit(0)
tp=inp.get('transcript_path')
if not tp or not os.path.exists(tp): sys.exit(0)
last=''
with open(tp,errors='ignore') as f:
  for line in f:
    try:
      o=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
      continue
    if o.get('type')!='assistant': continue
    c=o.get('message',{}).get('content',[])
    if not isinstance(c,list): continue
    ts=[b.get('text','') for b in c if isinstance(b,dict) and b.get('type')=='text']
    j='\n\n'.join(t for t in ts if t.strip())
    if j: last=j
spoken=re.sub(r'\`\`\`[\s\S]*?\`\`\`','',last)
spoken=re.sub(r'\`[^\`\n]+\`','',spoken)
spoken=spoken.strip()
if not spoken: sys.exit(0)
# Dispatch through storehouse so the :tts adapter (declared in
# /Users/christopheryoung/Projects/miette/body/voice/voice.hecksagon)
# renders via ElevenLabs + plays via afplay. Latest-wins cancellation
# lives in the kernel-floor dispatcher's pid file ; we just fire and
# return. Detached so the Stop hook isn't blocked by the ~2s curl.
bin='/Users/christopheryoung/Projects/hecks/rust/target/release/storehouse'
root='/Users/christopheryoung/Projects/miette/body'
if os.path.exists(bin):
  subprocess.Popen([bin, root, 'Voice::Voice.Speak', 'text='+spoken],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
" 2>/dev/null || true
